verdict.rationale: Aleph is an FP&A platform, so bulk operations are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows related automation: AI mapping agents that monitor new accounts and vendors, push/pull spreadsheet sync, and an agent that updates reports. None of it documents a capability to select or act on many items at once in a single bulk operation. Adjacent automation features do not earn credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
